title: Independent reading: Acts 1:1–11
subtitle: Read narrative transition, question, promise, and commission.
overview: Acts opens by linking a former account to a new narrative, then shifts through question, promise, commission, and angelic speech. Mark each transition.
The passage combines infinitives, future forms, and direct speech; keep their governing verbs and speakers visible.

items.grc: ἀλλὰ λήμψεσθε δύναμιν ἐπελθόντος τοῦ ἁγίου πνεύματος ἐφ᾽ ὑμᾶς.
items.en: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you.

items.grc: καὶ ἔσεσθέ μου μάρτυρες ἕως ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς.
items.en: And you will be my witnesses to the end of the earth.
